gifts: LEGO City Main Street Building Set
recommendation.rationale: These sets let Lucas expand his city and space adventures while encouraging creative engineering. Each kit is designed for ages 6‑10, offers safe, easy‑to‑connect pieces, and sparks storytelling both on the ground and among the stars.

wish.text: Dear Lucas, Santa sees that your wonderful imagination at eight is already building amazing adventures. I hear the sparkle of tiny bricks forming bustling streets, soaring rockets, and magnetic marvels that will bring your dreams to life. Merry Christmas!
